title: 부산광역시 해운대구와 금정구의 관할구역 변경에 관한 규정 / queue:ADDENDUM:30671:20200512:00001:part:1/1
title_original: 부산광역시 해운대구와 금정구의 관할구역 변경에 관한 규정
full_text:
ADDENDA <No. 30671, May 12, 2020>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on the date on which 30 days have elapsed after its promulgation.

Article 2 (Transitional Measures concerning Administrative Dispositions, etc.) With respect to the areas incorporated into another local government under this Decree, a public notification, disposition, or other act made before this Decree enters into force by the head of the former local government or the head of an agency under its jurisdiction shall be deemed a public notification, disposition, or other act made by the head of the local government having jurisdiction over the relevant area under this Decree or the head of an agency under its jurisdiction. An application, report, or other act filed or made with the head of the former local government or the head of an agency under its jurisdiction shall be deemed an application, report, or other act filed or made with the head of the local government having jurisdiction over the relevant area under this Decree or the head of an agency under its jurisdiction.

Article 3 (Relationship with Other Statutes and Regulations) Where another statute or regulation in force at the time this Decree enters into force prescribes all or part of the area of an autonomous district changed under this Decree as a district or jurisdictional area, that area shall, until the relevant statute or regulation is amended after this Decree enters into force, be deemed to belong to the district or jurisdictional area of the autonomous district as it existed before the change under this Decree, and the relevant statute or regulation shall apply accordingly.
